connector.name: MGO - Multi-chain Gas Optimizer
connector.registryDescription: Find the cheapest EVM chain across up to 9 networks with savings %. Pay-per-call via x402 on Base.
connector.summary: Hosted at x402-gas-api.vercel.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package chain-ops-mgo. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dlrjsdl200-byte account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
